title: Verificación: Qwen beats Gemma 4 12B in real hardware tests (speed, JSON reliability, F1)
summary: Claim revisado: Gemma 4 12B is a strong local multimodal model with good benchmarks and efficiency. Evidencia: Direct comparison on Dell Pro14: Qwen 3.5B 3.6× faster, 3.2× higher throughput, 100% valid JSON (Gemma ~50%), +67% F1 on tags. Conclusion: Qwen 'destroza' in speed and reliability on real hardware.. Caveat editorial: Model quality + structured output reliability can outweigh raw architecture/marketing claims; Gemma 4 underperforms Qwen in practical agentic/JSON tasks on same hardware.. Reproducibilidad: medium - specific hardware and metrics reported in context of Gemma 4 discussion.
